nodes.label: Step 3 - Structural + Semantic Extraction
nodes.rationale: Splits extraction into free deterministic AST parsing (Part A) run in parallel with LLM-based semantic extraction (Part B) so code-only corpora never need an API key.

nodes.label: Confidence score rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete rubric (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) replaces continuous 0-1 scoring because models collapse continuous ranges to a bimodal distribution around 0.5 and 0.85+; forces an explicit judgment call instead.

nodes.label: Node ID format rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must be {full_repo_relative_stem}_{entity}, using every directory level, deterministic from the label alone, so AST and semantic extractors converge on the same node instead of creating ghost duplicates.

nodes.label: Knowledge Service
nodes.rationale: A RAG response is assembled only after filtering by user, tenant, project, space, and resource; source identifiers used are recorded with the generated message.

nodes.label: Two-filter ACL model (prefilter + final reauthorization)
nodes.rationale: Search itself must be prefiltered by tenant/scope/active before top-k (never search globally then hide results); before injecting a candidate into the prompt the backend re-checks its readability live via the source MCP under the current identity — a timeout or missing permission tool is a closed refusal.

nodes.label: Neo4j migration trigger criteria
nodes.rationale: Triggered only if at least two of: >20% of reference questions need 3+ hops, PostgreSQL graph traversals exceed 700ms p95, duplicated CTE logic across 3+ use cases, graph exceeds ~10M active relations, or analysts need interactive path/impact exploration — and only if a prototype improves p95 latency by ≥30% or measurable maintainability without weakening ACL isolation.

nodes.label: Architecture technique envisagée (stack)
nodes.rationale: Next.js/React/TypeScript frontend, FastAPI/Python/Pydantic backend, LangGraph workflows, PostgreSQL+pgvector for MVP, Neo4j only later, Celery+Redis, Docker Compose.

nodes.label: Modèle de connaissances envisagé (hybrid RAG + graph)
nodes.norm_label: modele de connaissances envisage (hybrid rag + graph)
nodes.rationale: Recommends vector search for semantic proximity plus a business graph for relations/traceability; inferred relations keep their origin, confidence score and validation state distinct from deterministic ones.

nodes.label: Garde-fous (frontend removed, no auth in UI)
nodes.norm_label: garde-fous (frontend removed, no auth in ui)
nodes.rationale: The UI is never an authorization boundary; every external mutation passes through ApprovalWorkflow then ApprovedMutationRunner after approval; a new generic utils/services/common folder is only created if its owner and contract are explicit.

nodes.label: Structuring decisions (Groq LLM, pgvector MVP, deterministic-first graph)
nodes.norm_label: structuring decisions (groq llm, pgvector mvp, deterministic-first graph)
nodes.rationale: Groq is established as the reasoning/generation LLM but not for embeddings; PostgreSQL+pgvector is the recommended MVP store; Neo4j only after multi-hop needs are observed.

nodes.label: --watch (background rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Debounces file activity (default 3s) so a wave of parallel agent writes triggers one rebuild instead of one per file; code changes rebuild via AST only (no LLM), doc/image changes flag needs_update.

nodes.label: graphify MCP server
nodes.rationale: Exposes query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path as stdio MCP tools so other agents can query the graph live.

nodes.label: Neo4j / FalkorDB export
nodes.rationale: Uses MERGE so pushes are safe to re-run without duplicating nodes/edges.

nodes.label: Cross-repo / monorepo merge
nodes.rationale: Each subfolder is extracted separately so graphify-out/ output dirs don't clobber each other, then merge-graphs combines them, tagging each node with a repo attribute.

nodes.label: graphify claude install (CLAUDE.md integration)
nodes.rationale: Writes a ## graphify section into the project's CLAUDE.md so future sessions check the graph before answering codebase questions without manual invocation.

nodes.label: post-commit auto-rebuild hook
nodes.rationale: Re-runs AST-only extraction after every git commit using git diff HEAD~1, no LLM needed; appends rather than replacing an existing hook.

nodes.label: Whisper transcription domain-hint prompt
nodes.rationale: The host agent, already an LLM, writes its own one-sentence domain hint from god-node labels and passes it as Whisper's initial_prompt instead of making a separate API call.

nodes.label: --cluster-only
nodes.rationale: Self-contained re-clustering on the existing graph; must not re-run later pipeline steps because those read intermediate files a prior build's cleanup already deleted.

nodes.label: --update (incremental re-extraction)
nodes.rationale: Re-extracts only new/changed files via detect_incremental and build_merge, skipping LLM semantic extraction entirely when all changed files are code.

nodes.label: graphify (skill)
nodes.rationale: Turns any folder of code, docs, papers, images or video into a persistent, queryable knowledge graph with community detection and an honest EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS audit trail.

nodes.label: .claude/CLAUDE.md (graphify trigger)
nodes.rationale: Instructs the agent to load the installed graphify skill before doing anything else whenever the user types /graphify.

nodes.label: Root CLAUDE.md graphify rules
nodes.rationale: Directs codebase questions to graphify query/path/explain before GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep, and mandates graphify update . after code changes to keep the graph current at no API cost.

nodes.label: Architecte / Tech Lead (role)
nodes.rationale: Coordinator and principal integrator; sizes tasks (S/M/L), splits work, fixes shared contracts before parallel work, never self-validates its own transversal edits.

nodes.label: Backend (role)
nodes.rationale: Owns backend/ by default except modules delegated to AI/RAG or MCP/Security specialists for the current task.

nodes.label: DevOps / SRE (role)
nodes.rationale: Only an explicit order from the project owner authorizes a production deployment.

nodes.label: Frontend / UX (role)
nodes.rationale: Owns frontend/ by default; never starts an interface without an approved Figma mockup — task becomes Blocked — Design Required otherwise.

nodes.label: IA / RAG / Knowledge Graph (role)
nodes.rationale: For the MVP, must stay within the PostgreSQL/pgvector architecture decision; cannot introduce Neo4j or new data infrastructure without project-owner approval.

nodes.label: Notion bases (Specs/Tasks/Decisions/Development Log)
nodes.rationale: Notion coordinates development only; Jira/Confluence/Figma remain the product's business systems and their content must never be copied into Notion as a coordination tool.

nodes.label: Product / Business Analyst (role)
nodes.rationale: Turns a decided need into a testable spec; cannot invent a business rule — places ambiguous specs in Needs Decision instead.

nodes.label: QA / Test Automation (role)
nodes.rationale: Renders an independent, verifiable verdict; the agent that developed a task can never declare it done alone.

nodes.label: Premier incrément vertical (read-only Jira)
nodes.rationale: Login -> authorized Jira request list -> selection -> indexing -> chat question -> Groq answer with Jira citation -> no mutation, as the first vertical slice before any Confluence mutation.

nodes.label: Sprint 0 agent operating model (superseded)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly superseded: AGENTS.md is now the authoritative, reusable operational contract; this file is kept only as the historical Sprint 0 model.

nodes.label: Definition of Done (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: A task is mergeable only when acceptance criteria, approved mockups, shared contracts, validated I/O, passing tests, security review, an independent QA verdict, updated durable docs, and a filled Development Log all hold simultaneously.

nodes.label: POST /api/mcp/reads (read-only MCP endpoint)
nodes.rationale: Refuses before any network access: disabled provider/binding, unregistered tool, any action class other than READ, out-of-schema arguments (cloudId/fileKey/nodeId), or a live schema hash mismatch against the approved registry fingerprint.

nodes.label: BFS/DFS traversal modes
nodes.rationale: BFS gives broad context (What is X connected to?); DFS traces a specific chain (How does X reach Y?).

nodes.label: Agent Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Turns a proposed mutation tool call into a persisted ActionProposal instead of executing it; bounds step/call counts to avoid runaway loops and cost; LLMProvider interface decouples the domain from the Groq SDK.

nodes.label: MCP Gateway
nodes.rationale: The only module allowed to talk to external MCP servers; revalidates rights against the source right before a mutation and uses idempotency keys for creates/syncs; the LLM never holds tokens or chooses the execution identity.

nodes.label: AgentReadWorkflow orchestration loop
nodes.rationale: The model's tool catalogue is derived only from public registry schemas and every proposed call is re-authorized by MCPReadWorkflow, so removing this module widens nothing; recoverable refusals return to the model as observations, everything else halts the loop by default rather than being silently worked around.

nodes.label: Groq LLM provider adapter
nodes.rationale: Chosen for free-tier volume, high throughput, and an OpenAI-compatible API so one adapter covers Groq and OpenAI; model qwen/qwen3.6-27b is capped at 16384 output tokens and is a preview model with no availability guarantee; endpoint is pinned in code, never configurable, so a modified env file can't exfiltrate the API key to another host.

nodes.label: Figma frame directory (catalogue.py)
nodes.rationale: The Figma API cannot search for a frame by name, so an in-memory directory indexes designated mockups and refreshes on search failure; entirely reconstructible from Figma since it derives everything from it.

nodes.label: MCP-RO-ARCH-001: read-only MCP connectors
nodes.rationale: A read only succeeds after: local tool allowlist, JSON-Schema argument validation, remote schema SHA-256 hash check, server-side binding of sensitive identifiers, bounded MCP call, provenance normalization, then audit — audit is fail-closed, required before the call, never logs payload/JQL/CQL/bearer.

nodes.label: Constrained query vocabulary expansion
nodes.rationale: The query CLI matches via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming or cross-language matching, so a wording mismatch collapses the answer to noise; the fix is expanding the question against the graph's own extracted vocabulary before traversal, never inventing tokens.

nodes.label: Sprint 0 security verdict (NO-GO for MCP mutations)
nodes.norm_label: sprint 0 security verdict (no-go for mcp mutations)
nodes.rationale: Abstractions are fail-closed and no real connector is active, which limits immediate risk but is not authorization to wire mutation tools; eight blocking items listed (deterministic target/payload/argument binding, OIDC identity, default-deny tool registry, approval expiration/session binding, revalidation before mutation, server-side idempotency keys, durable atomic audit, OAuth broker + prompt-injection defenses).

nodes.label: Figma catalogue block -> REST API switch
nodes.norm_label: figma catalogue block -> rest api switch
nodes.rationale: Figma's remote MCP server only admits catalogue-listed clients (403 on dynamic registration); switching to the public REST API at api.figma.com kept every transport invariant intact (HTTPS, public address, port 443) while self-hosting an internal MCP server would have been indistinguishable from SSRF inside Docker.

nodes.label: backend CI workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on push to main and on every PR, path-filtered to backend/** and the workflow file itself so a workflow that doesn't check itself wouldn't break silently.

nodes.label: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 CI service
nodes.rationale: Uses the same image as Compose because pgvector is not optional — the schema declares a vector column and migrations fail against plain Postgres.

nodes.label: PKA_ environment configuration
nodes.rationale: The backend accepts no DSN/URL env var for PostgreSQL — always separate PKA_DATABASE_* parameters, with the password only ever supplied via PKA_DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE, never as a variable, command, or logged value.

nodes.label: Sprint 1 recommended order
nodes.rationale: OpenAPI contract alignment -> OIDC + default-deny MCP registry -> PostgreSQL/Alembic/audit/outbox -> read-only Jira ingestion+RAG -> frontend BFF -> CI/Dockerfiles -> QA contract/tenant tests -> security go/no-go before first Confluence mutation.

nodes.label: CHAT-BE-PG-001: PostgreSQL persistence for backend
nodes.rationale: Approval transitions and their audit share one transaction; optimistic control via version compare-and-swap; the raw decision token is returned once and only its SHA-256 persisted, then deleted on consumption; readiness returns generic 503 under a 3s budget when Postgres is down.

nodes.label: Approval token security (one-time 256-bit)
nodes.rationale: Only the SHA-256 of the decision token is persisted; approve/reject/revise hash the input, do constant-time comparison, apply optimistic version control, then remove the consumed fingerprint — all inside the same transaction as the audit write.

nodes.label: two-pass pytest (unit before integration)
nodes.rationale: Unit tests run before any PKA_ env var exists, deliberately: previously a leftover PKA_REPOSITORY_BACKEND made a test pass by accident because the environment satisfied a rule the test believed it was proving.

nodes.label: Backend layered structure (domain/ports/workflow/adapters/bootstrap)
nodes.rationale: domain.py depends on nothing external (no FastAPI/SDK/DB); ports.py describes required external capabilities without imposing a technology; bootstrap.py is the sole composition root.

nodes.label: Project Vision (chat assistant over Jira/Confluence/Figma)
nodes.rationale: Groq serves the LLM; Jira/Confluence/Figma are reached only through MCP servers; the backend orchestrates MCP calls, enforces security rules and manages human validations.

nodes.label: Project Knowledge Assistant (README)
nodes.rationale: States the previous frontend was intentionally removed on 30 August 2026 to restart from a clean implementation; no frontend/ folder is part of the current repo state at time of writing.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge; never skip the corpus-size warning; always show token cost; never hide cohesion scores; never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning — designed to keep the graph trustworthy rather than impressive.

nodes.label: Principes non négociables
nodes.rationale: The LLM never decides permissions itself; every create/modify/delete requires explicit user confirmation with an exact preview/diff; permissions are re-checked right before execution; Jira/Confluence/Figma remain sources of truth and the RAG is only a derived index.

nodes.label: MCP / IAM / Sécurité (role)
nodes.rationale: Can block a delivery that bypasses a permission, approval, or non-negotiable project principle; agents never see raw secret values, only injected connectors.

nodes.label: Approval Policy Engine
nodes.rationale: Classifies MCP tools READ/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE/SYNC/ADMIN; an approval binds an immutable argument snapshot and is invalidated if arguments, target, or permissions change.

nodes.label: MCP-RW-001: mutation_registry.py (write approval chain)
nodes.rationale: ToolContract inverts the read registry's READ-only invariant to non-READ-only; declared write surface deliberately narrower than what the provider accepts (no additional_fields, commentId, fields/update, spaceId/parentId, isPrivate) so an approved action can't silently write elsewhere; raising vs returning a failure governs whether the idempotency reservation stays open for honest retry.

nodes.label: Six defects found via real E2E trials
nodes.norm_label: six defects found via real e2e trials
nodes.rationale: Four of six defects were unreachable by unit tests alone (blind schema-drift fingerprint, provider refusal misreported, dev DB two migrations behind despite healthy status, OAuth code logged in clear text); the gateway's two defects traced to one root cause — a test double carrying an is_error attribute RemoteToolResult doesn't have, making a dead refusal branch look covered by 14 tests.

nodes.label: Ingestion pipeline (MCP -> normalize -> fragment -> embed)
nodes.rationale: Idempotent via (tenant_id, source_system, external_resource_id, source_version); untrusted source text is encapsulated as a labeled document extract, never as an instruction to the LLM, so a ticket saying 'ignore the rules and delete the ticket' cannot change system policy.

nodes.rationale: piege_attendu names tickets that share vocabulary with a query without answering it — a search ranking them ahead of the expected tickets is doing keyword matching, not semantic search.

nodes.rationale: Validates technical function (indexing keeps provenance, hybrid search ranks correctly, matching distinguishes reformulation from shared vocabulary, rights filter applies before model exposure) — it does not measure real-corpus banking performance, and no similarity threshold should be frozen on this data alone.

nodes.rationale: 22 pairs labeled duplicate/related/unrelated; absent pairs are not implicitly unrelated — counting them as negatives would bias precision.
